job.style: a news-style report about a real-world situation

response.passage: On October 12, the City Zoological Park witnessed a peculiar incident during the morning feeding session. Mr. Rajesh Khanna, the head zookeeper, reported that the enclosure for the Himalayan Red Pandas was left unlocked due to a technical failure in the automated latch system. As a result, the two pandas wandered into the adjacent bamboo garden, causing a brief panic among the visitors. Ms. Sunita Rao, a local botanist, was present at the scene and noted that the animals were attracted to the garden because the bamboo shoots were particularly fresh that morning. By 10:30 AM, the security team had safely returned both animals to their habitat. The park management has since announced that they will replace all electronic locks with manual ones to prevent future escapes. While some visitors suggested that the pandas were trying to escape the heat, the park authorities clarified that the animals were simply following their natural foraging instincts. No injuries were reported, and the park resumed normal operations by noon.
response.summary: A technical failure at the City Zoological Park led to two red pandas escaping their enclosure. The animals were safely retrieved after they were found eating fresh bamboo in a nearby garden.
